title: Extending Probability-One Differential Analysis to Four-Round SPNs
summary: Probability-one differentials have been analyzed for two-round SPNs; the open task is to extend this to four rounds using superboxes with non-maximal boomerang uniformity.

formal_statement.body: For four-round substitution-permutation networks (SPNs), extend the probability-one differential analysis considered for two-round SPNs by replacing individual S-boxes with superboxes, where a superbox consists of two SPN rounds, and derive conditions guaranteeing that such a superbox does not have maximal boomerang uniformity. The unresolved question is to identify the relevant structural or cryptanalytic conditions under which this non-maximal-uniformity property holds, so that the probability-one differential analysis can be generalized from two rounds to four rounds.

scope.domain: Differential cryptanalysis of four-round substitution-permutation networks using two-round SPN superboxes.
parameters: Four SPN rounds — target network depth for the extension
Two SPN rounds — network depth represented by each superbox
scope.unresolved_remainder: Identify structural or cryptanalytic conditions under which a two-round SPN superbox has non-maximal boomerang uniformity, enabling the probability-one differential analysis to extend to four rounds.

citations.label: On Perfect Linear Approximations and Differentials over Two-Round SPNs

progress.summary: The source presents the four-round extension as future work and singles out ensuring non-maximal boomerang uniformity for two-round superboxes as the unresolved technical question.
citation_labels: Christof Beierle et al., On Perfect Linear Approximations and Differentials over Two-Round SPNs
